name: @ship/sail-site
description: The SAIL docs site — a deck app: docs, the 9-lesson tutorial, the component library, and an interactive component playground. SAIL's own red identity, light + dark.

scripts.gen: bun run wasm && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p sail-compiler -- prop-registry) && (cd ../../packages/sail/grammar && bun run generate) && bun scripts/gen-runtime-surface.ts && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli --bin deck-bake -- build-assets) && bun scripts/gen-tutorial.ts
scripts.dev: bun run gen && (cd ../.. && cargo run -q -p deck-cli -- dev --project apps/sail-site --addr ${SAIL_SITE_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:7890})
scripts.build: bun run gen && bun run build:static
scripts.deploy:pages: npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name sail-site
scripts.qa: echo 'L1 matrix is not the docs site. Use: bun crates/sail/compiler/tests/l1-matrix/probe.ts' && exit 2
